svg.aria-label: Tracker seam and its first adapter
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Tracker seam and its first adapter
svg.desc: The engine talks only to the provider-neutral Tracker trait; GitHubTracker is the first implementation, and every one of its requests funnels through a single GhRunner call.
